title: Stop asking subagents for report files Claude Code refuses
body:
Outcome: lead and lane instructions no longer ask subagents to write report files; findings travel in the final reply.
Why: on 2026-11-09 the refill lane's Write of .krn/runs/roadmap-refill-4/report.md was refused by Claude Code ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"), while krn-lead said a subagent writes a file and returns its path.
Proof: SKILL.md and lanes.md say the final reply is the report.
Scope: .agents/skills/krn-lead.
